```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
team_season <- dbReadTable(con, "team_season")
team_draft <- dbReadTable(con, "team_draft")
teams <- dbReadTable(con, "teams")
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")
player_stats_seasons <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT DISTINCT playerId, season FROM player_stats"
)
stopifnot(nrow(team_season) > 0, nrow(team_draft) > 0, nrow(picks) > 0)

# Decision 0003 places Notre Dame in the Power tier, but the season-aware
# lookup tiers every FBS independent as Group of 5; apply the team override
# here so the exhibits match the tier definitions in section 2.1.
nd_power <- function(df) {
  mutate(
    df,
    tier_label = if_else(
      team == "Notre Dame" & tier_label == "Group of 5",
      "Power",
      tier_label
    )
  )
}
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- c(
  "Power" = "#1d4ed8",
  "Group of 5" = "#f59e0b",
  "FCS and below" = "#6b7280"
)
team_season <- team_season |>
  nd_power() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
team_draft <- nd_power(team_draft)
stopifnot(
  all(team_season$tier_label[team_season$team == "Notre Dame"] == "Power")
)

first_class <- 2014L # full observable careers (roster starts 2010)
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is in progress
played <- filter(team_season, games_played > 0, season <= last_season)
n_played_2025 <- n_distinct(played$team[played$season == 2025L])
stopifnot(n_played_2025 > 600)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-31. Rosters and
stat lines start with the 2010 season; the 2026 season is still being
played, so every season-level exhibit stops at 2025, and draft counts cover
the classes of 2014 through 2026.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

In 2025, `r fmt(n_played_2025)` college programs played at least one
recorded football game, from Alabama and Ohio State down to Division III,
and this post maps how they are grouped, what the data records about each,
and how unevenly the NFL draft draws from them. The answers set up two
later posts: which schools produce draftees at each position, and whether
winning explains it.

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Teams are grouped into conferences, and conferences into three tiers

The table defines every term the post uses; a tier is set season by
season, so a school that changes conference can change tier.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                   , ~Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ,
  "Division"              , "The NCAA level a school plays at: FBS (the top division), FCS (the next level down), Division II, and Division III."                                                                                                         ,
  "Conference"            , "A league of schools that schedule each other and share a championship, such as the SEC or the Big Sky. A few FBS schools are independents and belong to no football conference."                                         ,
  "Tier"                  , "Our three-level grouping of conferences by competitive level, set season by season because schools change conferences."                                                                                                     ,
  "Power"                 , "The top tier: the SEC, Big Ten, ACC, and Big 12; the Pac-12 through 2023 (the Pac-10 before 2011); the Big East through 2012; and Notre Dame."                                                                               ,
  "Group of 5"            , "The rest of FBS: the American Athletic (from 2013), Conference USA, Mid-American, Mountain West, Sun Belt, Western Athletic (through 2012), the two-school Pac-12 from 2024, and the independents other than Notre Dame." ,
  "FCS and below"         , "Every school outside FBS: the FCS (such as the Big Sky or Missouri Valley), Division II, and Division III."                                                                                                                  ,
  "Team-season"           , "One school in one season."                                                                                                                                                                                                   ,
  "Roster player-season"  , "One player listed on one school's roster in one season."                                                                                                                                                                     ,
  "Stat line"             , "At least one recorded statistic (a carry, catch, tackle, or kick) for a player in a season."                                                                                                                                ,
  "Position group"        , "The roster position, grouped: quarterback, running back (fullbacks included), receiver, tight end, offensive line, defensive line, linebacker, defensive back, and special teams. A roster with no position, or a generic one such as athlete, is 'Position not recorded'." ,
  "Draft class"           , "The players picked in one year's NFL draft; the class of 2016 was drafted in April 2016, after the 2015 college season."                                                                                                    ,
  "Draft-day school"      , "The college the NFL draft lists for a player."                                                                                                                                                                               ,
  "Credited pick"         , "A draft pick traced to the last college roster the player was on before the draft. A pick whose player appears on no roster cannot be credited."
) |>
  kable(caption = "Terms used throughout.")
```

## 3. Results

```{r}
#| label: s31-compute
#| include: false
fbs <- played |>
  filter(classification == "fbs") |>
  # the Pac-10 became the Pac-12 in 2011: a rename, not a move
  mutate(league = if_else(conference == "Pac-10", "Pac-12", conference))
moves <- fbs |>
  arrange(team, season) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  mutate(from = lag(league), from_tier = lag(as.character(tier_label))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(from), from != league)
n_moves <- nrow(moves)
n_movers <- n_distinct(moves$team)
fbs_n <- count(fbs, season, name = "teams")
fbs_2010 <- fbs_n$teams[fbs_n$season == 2010L]
fbs_2025 <- fbs_n$teams[fbs_n$season == 2025L]
n_conf_2025 <- n_distinct(
  fbs$league[fbs$season == 2025L & fbs$league != "FBS Independents"]
)
wave1 <- sum(moves$season %in% 2011:2014)
wave2 <- sum(moves$season %in% 2023:2024)
pac12_2024 <- sort(fbs$team[fbs$season == 2024L & fbs$league == "Pac-12"])
```

### 3.1 FBS grew from 120 to 136 teams, and 61 schools changed conference at least once

The table counts teams and conferences by tier in the seasons around the two
waves of realignment, the figure shows when the `r n_moves` conference
changes happened, and the tile chart traces every school that moved.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
conf_by_tier <- played |>
  filter(conference != "FBS Independents" | is.na(conference)) |>
  group_by(season, tier_label) |>
  summarise(conferences = n_distinct(conference), .groups = "drop")
teams_by_tier <- count(played, season, tier_label, name = "teams")
sel <- c(2010L, 2012L, 2013L, 2014L, 2023L, 2024L, 2025L)
teams_by_tier |>
  left_join(conf_by_tier, by = c("season", "tier_label")) |>
  filter(season %in% sel) |>
  mutate(
    cell = if_else(
      tier_label == "FCS and below",
      fmt(teams),
      paste0(teams, " in ", conferences)
    )
  ) |>
  select(season, tier_label, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tier_label, values_from = cell) |>
  left_join(count(moves, season, name = "moved"), by = "season") |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    `Power teams in conferences` = Power,
    `Group of 5 teams in conferences` = `Group of 5`,
    `FCS and below teams` = `FCS and below`,
    `FBS teams that changed conference` = coalesce(moved, 0L)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Teams that played at least one recorded game, and the conferences they played in, by tier, in seasons around the two waves of realignment. Conference counts leave out the FBS independents. FCS-and-below counts grow from 2021 because Division II and III games enter the data then."
  )
```

```{r}

#| fig-height: 6
moves_n <- moves |>
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-compute
#| include: false
division_order <- c("FBS", "FCS", "Division II and below")
division_colors <- c(
  "FBS" = "#1d4ed8",
  "FCS" = "#0f766e",
  "Division II and below" = "#6b7280"
)
coverage <- played |>
  mutate(
    division = case_when(
      classification == "fbs" ~ "FBS",
      classification == "fcs" ~ "FCS",
      TRUE ~ "Division II and below"
    ),
    division = factor(division, levels = division_order)
  ) |>
  group_by(season, division) |>
  summarise(
    played = n(),
    with_stats = sum(has_stat_lines),
    with_roster = sum(n_roster > 0),
    depth = median(n_stat_players[has_stat_lines]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(share = with_stats / played)
cov_at <- function(s, d, col) coverage[[col]][coverage$season == s & coverage$division == d]
fcs_pre <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season <= 2019L)
fcs_post <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season >= 2021L)
low_post <- coverage |> filter(division == "Division II and below", season >= 2021L)
fbs_depth_2015 <- cov_at(2015L, "FBS", "depth")
fbs_depth_2016 <- cov_at(2016L, "FBS", "depth")
```

### 3.2 Every FBS team has stat lines every season, FCS teams only from 2021, and Division II and III teams almost never

The table counts, for each division and season, the teams that played and
the teams with at least one player stat line; the first figure tracks that
share, and the second shows how many players per team carry a stat line,
which doubles in 2016 when deeper stat records begin.

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
coverage |>
  mutate(cell = paste0(with_stats, " of ", played)) |>
  select(season, division, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = division, values_from = cell) |>
  rename(Season = season) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Teams with at least one player stat line, of the teams that played at least one recorded game, by division and season, 2010 to 2025."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-compute
#| include: false
# credited picks: players whose final college season was 2013 to 2025,
# i.e. the draft classes of 2014 to 2026
credited <- filter(team_draft, season >= first_class - 1L, season <= last_season)
group_picks <- credited |>
  group_by(group = position_group) |>
  summarise(picks = sum(n_drafted), .groups = "drop")
ol_cov <- roster |>
  filter(season <= last_season) |>
  distinct(playerId, season, position) |>
  left_join(
    mutate(player_stats_seasons, has_stat = TRUE),
    by = c("playerId", "season")
  ) |>
  mutate(group = position_group(position), has_stat = coalesce(has_stat, FALSE)) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), with_stat = sum(has_stat), share = mean(has_stat), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(group_picks, by = "group") |>
  mutate(pick_share = picks / sum(picks)) |>
  arrange(share)
ol <- filter(ol_cov, group == "Offensive line")
others <- filter(ol_cov, !group %in% c("Offensive line", "Position not recorded"))
```

### 3.3 Offensive linemen supply one in six credited draft picks, but only 6% of their roster seasons carry a stat line

The table and figure set each position group's roster seasons against those
with a stat line; offensive linemen block rather than carry, catch, or
tackle, so they fill rosters but almost never in the stat sheets,
which is why the draft rates in the next two posts count everyone who left a
roster rather than everyone with a stat line.

```{r}
#| label: s33-table
ol_cov |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    `Roster player-seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    `With a stat line` = fmt(with_stat),
    `Share with a stat line` = pct(share),
    `Credited draft picks` = fmt(picks),
    `Share of picks` = pct(pick_share)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Roster player-seasons and how many carry a stat line, 2010 to 2025, with credited draft picks for the classes of 2014 to 2026, by position group."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p <- ggplot(ol_cov, aes(share, reorder(group, share), fill = group == "Offensive line")) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        group, ": ", fmt(with_stat), " of ", fmt(seasons), " roster seasons with a stat line (", pct(share), ")\n",
        fmt(picks), " credited draft picks (", pct(pick_share), " of all)"
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct(share, 0)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#b91c1c", `FALSE` = "#9ca3af"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.8)) +
  labs(
    x = "Roster player-seasons with a stat line, 2010 to 2025",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Offensive linemen are on rosters but not in the stat sheets",
    subtitle = paste0("Yet they are ", pct(ol$pick_share, 0), " of credited draft picks; hover a bar for counts")
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s34-compute
#| include: false
school_picks <- credited |>
  arrange(team, season) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    picks = sum(n_drafted),
    # the school's tier and conference in its latest credited season
    tier = last(tier_label),
    conference = last(conference),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(picks > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(picks), team) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number(), cum_share = cumsum(picks) / sum(picks))
total_credited <- sum(school_picks$picks)
n_schools <- nrow(school_picks)
half_n <- which(school_picks$cum_share >= 0.5)[1]
fbs_teams_window <- played |>
  filter(season >= first_class - 1L, classification == "fbs") |>
  distinct(team) |>
  pull()
fbs_with_pick <- sum(fbs_teams_window %in% school_picks$team)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).

  ~who           , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Carson Wentz" , "2573079"       ,
  "Trey Lance"   , "4383351"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: s35-compute
#| include: false
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
# a pick is traced when its player is on a roster before the draft year
traced_ids <- picks |>
  filter(
    !is.na(playerId),
    !playerId %in% reused,
    year >= first_class,
    year <= last_season + 1L
  ) |>
  inner_join(distinct(roster, playerId, season), by = "playerId", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(season < year) |>
  distinct(playerId) |>
  pull()
# draft-day school's tier in its latest recorded season before the draft
school_tier <- team_season |>
  filter(!is.na(tier_label)) |>
  transmute(collegeTeam = team, tier_season = season, tier = as.character(tier_label), conference)
window_picks <- picks |>
  filter(year >= first_class, year <= last_season + 1L) |>
  left_join(school_tier, by = join_by(collegeTeam, closest(year > tier_season))) |>
  mutate(traced = playerId %in% traced_ids)
id_picks <- window_picks |> filter(!is.na(playerId), !playerId %in% reused)
traced_share <- mean(id_picks$traced)
small <- filter(window_picks, tier == "FCS and below")
small_traced <- mean(small$traced)
fbs_traced <- mean(window_picks$traced[window_picks$tier %in% c("Power", "Group of 5")])
small_schools <- small |>
  group_by(collegeTeam) |>
  summarise(
    picks = n(),
    traced = sum(traced),
    conference = last(conference),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(picks), collegeTeam)
ndsu <- filter(small, collegeTeam == "North Dakota State")
star <- function(id) filter(picks, playerId == id)
wentz <- star(subjects$cfb_athlete_id[1])
lance <- star(subjects$cfb_athlete_id[2])
```

## 4. Summary

The data sees all of FBS, much of the FCS, and little below it, and within
what it sees the draft draws from a short list of schools.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Finding                                                   , ~Evidence                                                                                                                                                   ,
  "FBS grew, and realignment moved a large share of it"       , sprintf("%d FBS teams in 2010, %d in 2025; %d schools made %d conference changes.", fbs_2010, fbs_2025, n_movers, n_moves)                                    ,
  "Stat lines cover FBS fully and FCS only from 2021"         , sprintf("Every FBS team every season; at most %s of FCS teams through 2019, all from 2021.", pct(max(fcs_pre$share), 0))                                    ,
  "Offensive linemen are drafted but rarely have stat lines"  , sprintf("%s of offensive-line roster seasons have a stat line; linemen are %s of credited picks.", pct(ol$share, 0), pct(ol$pick_share, 0))                 ,
  "Half the credited picks come from 25 schools"              , sprintf("Top 25: %s of %s picks; top 10: %s.", pct(school_picks$cum_share[25]), fmt(total_credited), pct(school_picks$cum_share[10]))                       ,
  "Small schools produce picks the rosters often miss"        , sprintf("%d picks from FCS and below, %d from North Dakota State; %s traced to a roster.", nrow(small), nrow(ndsu), pct(small_traced, 0))
) |>
  kable(caption = "The findings and the numbers behind them.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Draft output is concentrated, but a raw pick count does not separate what a
school develops from how many players pass through it.

- The next post divides each school's picks by the players who left its
  roster, position by position, before calling any school a producer.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The stat sheets miss offensive linemen, and the rosters miss many small-school
draftees.

- A population built from stat lines nearly drops offensive linemen; counting
  everyone who left a roster keeps them.
- Small-school rosters are too incomplete for team-by-team rates, so FCS and
  below enter the next posts as one group.
:::

```{r}
#| label: caveats-pin
#| include: false
fcs_roster_2021 <- cov_at(2021L, "FCS", "with_roster")
fcs_roster_2022 <- cov_at(2022L, "FCS", "with_roster")
stopifnot(
  fcs_roster_2021 < 100L,
  fcs_roster_2022 == cov_at(2022L, "FCS", "played"),
  mean(!id_picks$tier[!id_picks$traced] %in% c("Power", "Group of 5")) > 0.6
)
```

Several caveats bound these numbers.

- FCS-and-below rosters are incomplete: `r fcs_roster_2021` FCS teams had a
  roster in 2021 and all `r fcs_roster_2022` that played in 2022, so roster
  counts jump between those seasons, and Division II and III rosters are
  nearly absent throughout.
- The FCS played most of its 2020 season in spring 2021, which the data
  barely records, so 2020 is a gap for every school below FBS.
- A pick is credited to the player's final college team, so a transfer's
  pick counts for his last stop, not the school that developed him.
- `r pct(traced_share)` of the 2014 to 2026 picks that carry an athlete id
  are credited to a team; the rest, mostly small-school players, are on no
  roster in the data.
- Offensive linemen rarely have stat lines, so any analysis built on stat
  lines rather than rosters undercounts them.
